messages:
jason_support: Heads up — customer acme-inc reported streaming "tokens/sec" dropping to 0 then showing negative values in the Console around 12:07 UTC. Screenshot attached in ticket #SUP-7421.
metrics-bot: Alert: streaming-ttft-rate-prod (acme-inc) returned -24 tokens/sec at 2026-03-16T12:07:12Z. Consumer lag normal.
maria_ops: Thanks. Can you paste a minimal repro and the exact dashboard time window? Also need the route/model and sample request id.
jason_support: Repro notes: happened on route /v1/stream:acme-chat, model redwood/a1. Sample request id 8a3f2c. Console window: last 5m. Quick log excerpt: ```2026-03-16T12:07:12.345Z ingest: route=/v1/stream tokens_total=-40 tokens_delta=-64 tokens/sec=-24```
kevin_analytics: That log looks like a negative delta on a monotonic counter. Two hypotheses: 1) counter reset (service restart) and delta calc didn't detect wrap/reset, 2) out-of-order replay for ingestion events. Both can yield negative deltas when we compute rate = current - previous.
sasha_console: Client-side patch idea: clamp negative rates to 0 in the chart renderer (fast mitigation). Backend should fix real source.
maria_ops: Can someone run a quick check on the aggregator job that computes per-customer rates? Query I used in dev: ```SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) as minute, sum(tokens_delta) FROM streaming_events WHERE customer='acme-inc' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 20;``` I see minutes with negative sums.
kevin_analytics: Running the same in prod shows a spike of negative values at 2026-03-16T12:07-12:09. Looking at the raw monotonic counter (`tokens_total`) we see a reset on the host that ingested that partition: ```host=ingest-4 tokens_total: 18446744073709551612 -> 12``` which suggests uint64 wrap vs restart. Our aggregator treats counters as signed and does naive subtraction -> negative.
jason_support: Customer is angry — quoting: "our metrics look broken and it's affecting ops". We should prioritize remediation and customer communication. Suggested immediate owner: eng-runtime + eng-ml infra.
maria_ops: Short term mitigations: (1) Dashboard clamp (sasha_console) to display 0 instead of negative; (2) Update aggregator delta logic to treat huge jumps/wraps as reset and compute delta = current when reset detected; (3) Backfill recompute for last 6 hours for acme-inc to remove bad negative buckets.
sasha_console: I'll add a frontend clamp with a feature flag and roll to prod (small PR). PR will be flagged as emergency UI patch. :eyes:
kevin_analytics: I'll prepare a backfill job: run backfill script `scripts/backfill_rates.py --customer acme-inc --hours 6` on analytics cluster, but we need a code change in aggregator to avoid reintroducing negatives before backfill completes.
maria_ops: Ops runbook notes for eng-runtime: check kafka consumer offsets for ingestion topic, inspect host ingest-4 restart events (kube events), and examine whether exporter uses unsigned counters incorrectly. If confirmed, escalate INCIDENT-ENG-2987.
jason_support: Repro on staging: I stomped ingest service (kubectl delete pod ingest-1) while streaming, then queried metrics and reproduced negative minute. Steps: 1) start steady stream 2) restart ingest pod 3) query minute-aggregator. Verified. Attaching commands.
metrics-bot: Deployment notice: aggregator v1.12 rolled at 2026-03-15T03:12:41Z (no known fixes for wrap-logic).
maria_ops: Proposed hotfix: change aggregator delta calc to: `if current < previous: // possible reset or wrap if (previous > UINT64_THRESHOLD) delta = current; else delta = 0;` then treat negative as 0. We'll need tests.
kevin_analytics: I'll open ENG-2987 and link SUP-7421. Will schedule backfill and pair with eng-runtime for hotfix.
sasha_console: Frontend clamp deployed to prod with FF. Charts no longer show negatives (temporary). :thumbsup:
jason_support: Notified customer (acme-inc) that we have a mitigation and an internal ticket. They asked for ETA — asking for an estimate on hotfix + backfill.
maria_ops: ETA: hotfix patch + CI ~ 6 hours (with code review), rollout ~1 hour canary, backfill ~2-4 hours depending on partition size. Will update SUP-7421 and ENG-2987.
kevin_analytics: Started backfill job at 2026-03-16T13:05Z, monitoring progress. Will paste finished log.
jason_support: Thanks team. Keep posting updates on SUP-7421 and ping @eng-runtime if anything blocks.
